thread:
mira.design: quick check - pushed a compact rail chip variant that collapses to a single 48px pill on mobile. staging: https://staging.console.redwood-inference.com/onboard/rail-chip-preview :mag_right:
lee_frontend: saw it. collapsing animation looks neat but keyboard focus lands behind the pill when expanded. reproducer: tab to pill -> press enter -> content opens but focus goes to page end.
alex_pm: main goal is fewer drop-offs in first 5 mins. also want to see api-key creation inside the flow. if the rail chip hides that, we lose signal.
devon_devex: will track `onboard.rail_open`, `onboard.chip_expand`, `onboard.api_key_created`. please confirm event payloads (user_id, variant, elapsed_ms).
sam_access: accessibility notes: 1) add skip-to-main link when chip present. 2) expansion should set focus to the first actionable item and restore focus to the chip when closed. 3) color contrast of the chip label is 3.6:1 rn, needs to be 4.5:1 for body text or increase size to meet AA.
lee_frontend: agree on focus restore. i'll implement focus restore using element.focus() on close. also changing chips to <button> elements (they were divs). will avoid tabindex hacks.
mira.design: copy options for the chip label — short strings only: "Try sample", "Run sample now", "Open sample projects". Which reads best on a 48px pill?
alex_pm: "Try sample" feels tight and action-y.
devon_devex: For sample curation: we've got 6 sample projects. Maybe reduce to top 3 by workspace language preference (python/js/ruby). Could we show a last-used sample first?
mira.design: Good idea 1: personalize by workspace language and surface "recommended" badge. But small devices need a simple list, not cards.
sam_access: Also need alt text for sample thumbnails and a descriptive label for screen reader users: e.g., "Sample: Customer Support Bot, opens new workspace". Don't rely on thumbnails alone.
uiqa: QA found a Safari bug where chip expansion flickers and checklist items overlap header. filing ticket #QA-214. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/a/qa-safari (placeholder).
lee_frontend: noted. sounds like z-index + will-change issue. i'll patch and add a regression test.
devon_devex: analytics plan: A/B variants: chip (collapsed) vs persistent rail vs checklist. track completion, time-to-api-key, sample-open rate, and 7-day retention. Split users 60/20/20.
alex_pm: agree. run for 14 days minimum and check segment by new-vs-returning. Want clear winner on api-key creation.
mira.design: UX tweak: when a sample is opened inline, show a small toast "Sample loaded in workspace" with an undo to close. helps users who accidentally open heavy samples. thoughts?
sam_access: toast should be reachable by keyboard (focusable) and announced via aria-live="polite". include a descriptive action label.
lee_frontend: implementation note: samples currently mount heavy model manifests, so ensure we lazy-load details and show skeletons. this reduces jank on open.
uiqa: regression checklist for release: keyboard nav, focus restore, contrast, aria labels, mobile collapse behavior, safari overlap fix.
mira.design: i'll update the mock with revised contrast and hidden SR text. uploading to design-assets: https://drive.google.com/fake-link (placeholder).
devon_devex: i'll add events and payload spec to the tracking doc and post it here once done.
lee_frontend: quick code sketch for focus restore i'll use:
```
const lastFocus = document.activeElement;
openChip().then(() => firstAction.focus());
closeChip(() => lastFocus && lastFocus.focus());
```
will make it robust across browsers.
alex_pm: sounds good. schedule: if fixes clear QA by EOD Friday, aim to roll to staging next Tue and kick off experiment Wed.
deploy-bot: New staging deploy: onboard/rail-chip-collapsed @ 2024-11-05T18:12:09Z :rocket:
mira.design: thanks all. i'll create the experiment doc and share test criteria. ping me for copy review 0:thumbsup:
